dbAssertions.name: OperationCase
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from operations_cases where case_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%'

dbAssertions.name: WorkItem
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from operations_work_items where work_item_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%'

dbAssertions.name: CommandSubmission
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from operations_command_submissions where case_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%'

dbAssertions.name: RejectedCommandSubmission
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from operations_command_submissions where case_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%' and status = 'rejected'

dbAssertions.name: RejectionTrace
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from operations_command_submissions where case_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%' and status = 'rejected' and failure_reason is not null and response_status_code in (403,422)

dbAssertions.name: DomainEvent
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from operations_domain_events where work_item_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%'

dbAssertions.name: LedgerTransaction
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from ledger_transactions where work_item_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%'

dbAssertions.name: LedgerEntry
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from ledger_entries entry join ledger_transactions tx on tx.ledger_transaction_id = entry.ledger_transaction_id where tx.work_item_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%'

dbAssertions.name: ProjectionCheckpoint
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from projection_checkpoints

dbAssertions.name: Lens
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from deposit_balance_projection

dbAssertions.name: EvidenceObject
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from evidence_objects where evidence_id like 'ev-d1-oam03-mpvp12ry-%'

dbAssertions.name: FactTrace
dbAssertions.query: select count(*) from operations_fact_responses response join operations_command_submissions submission on submission.submission_id = response.submission_id where submission.case_id like '%-oam03-mpvp12ry-%'
